gates.label: FOREX Hard Disable
gates.description: Blocks all FOREX picks from pipeline. Enabled while carry-factor research is in progress.

gates.label: CRYPTO UTC-Hour Death-Zone Filter
gates.description: Rejects CRYPTO picks during 06:00-11:00 UTC (0% WR window). Boosts 22:00 UTC.

gates.label: FOREX Session Gate (08-16 UTC)
gates.description: Blocks FOREX picks outside 08:00-16:00 UTC trading session.

gates.label: Safety Halt Gate
gates.description: Rejects ALL picks when safety_status verdict == STOP (Binance CB, severe drift).

gates.label: Anti-Overfit Validator
gates.description: Runs DSR/PBO anti-overfit checks on each pick's strategy.

gates.label: Swarm Tier Gate (M-010)
gates.description: Enforces min consensus tier for swarm-originated picks (default: strong=3+/66%+).

gates.label: Walk-Forward Failing Block
gates.description: Blocks strategies with FAILING walk-forward verdict from producing new picks.

gates.label: Decay Soft Demotion
gates.description: Auto-demotes strategies showing sustained WR decay in recent picks.

gates.label: HF Quality Gate
gates.description: Applies hedge-fund grade quality thresholds (PF/WR/n floors) before publish.

gates.label: BOND Minimum N Gate
gates.description: Blocks BOND picks until class reaches minimum resolved_n threshold (n≥30).

gates.label: ETF Tight Quality Gate
gates.description: Applies tighter PF/WR thresholds for ETF class until n≥150 OOS-ready.

gates.label: VIX + Yield Curve Score Bonus (EQUITY)
gates.description: Adds +15 score bonus for EQUITY picks when VIX<22 and YC spread>0 (risk-on).

gates.label: 15-Minute Timeframe Quarantine (M-028)
gates.description: Rejects picks on 15m timeframes. Default shadow (stamp-only); set=1 to enforce.

gates.label: CRYPTO Confidence Inversion Gate (M-034)
gates.description: Blocks high-confidence picks from anti-correlated CRYPTO sources. Shadow by default.

gates.label: BT/FWD WR Drift Gate
gates.description: Blocks strategies where BT WR diverges >2σ from forward WR. Shadow by default.

gates.label: Overconfidence Decay (Score Booster)
gates.description: Decays extreme scores (|score|>threshold) by 20% to prevent overconfidence blowups.

gates.label: Day-of-Week Gate (SUPREME EDGE)
gates.description: Restricts picks to statistically optimal days of week. Default OFF (shadow).

gates.label: Net-of-Cost Slippage / Expectancy Promotion Gate (P1/#7)
gates.description: Blocks MONEY_READY promotion when post-slippage expectancy is negative. ENFORCED by default (2026-05-19, swarm-settled Q1 verdict — the real money-ready promotion gate); set SLIPPAGE_PROMOTION_GATE_ENABLED=0 to disable.
